title: Two sprint runners share one host without stepping on each other
goal: autopilot.py runs at most two sprint runners at once and refuses a third; backlog.py plan or start refuses a sprint whose committed touches overlap those of another sprint a runner holds, naming the paths; landing and kbgit.py sync --push take a host-wide lock so two runners never rebase or push main at once, the holder named while the other waits

gates.question: How many sprint runners may run at once?
